slides.headline: GOOGLE'S WEATHERNEXT 3 IS ALREADY FASTER THAN EVERY NATIONAL WEATHER MODEL ON EARTH
slides.image_prompt: Sundar Pichai waist-up, wide-eyed triumph and awe on his face, holds a tablet chest-high showing a vivid orange street-level weather map — rain on one block, sun on the next. Google logo exactly as in the reference image glows large on the bright operations center wall behind him. Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain. Accent: vivid orange against electric blue.

slides.headline: YOUR WEATHER APP HAS BEEN RUNNING 70-YEAR-OLD EQUATIONS YOUR WHOLE LIFE
slides.body:
Every forecast on earth worked the same: feed atmospheric readings into a physics simulation, run the math, output a prediction.

But it only told you what was happening in your city, not your street

slides.headline: WEATHERNEXT 3 SKIPPED THE PHYSICS SIMULATION AND WATCHED REAL WEATHER INSTEAD
slides.body:
Instead of simulating the atmosphere, the AI learned directly from what weather actually does in the real world.

The result: faster predictions, and forecasts narrow enough to cover your block

slides.headline: NO EQUATIONS. JUST LIVE WEATHER.
slides.body: Then came the bill governments couldn't explain

slides.headline: GOVERNMENTS SPENT BILLIONS ON WEATHER SUPERCOMPUTERS. GOOGLE BYPASSED ALL OF IT.
slides.body:
National weather services run physics models on some of the most expensive computers ever built.

WeatherNext 3 read live data directly, your phone could know it's raining on your block before they do.

slides.headline: THE AI THAT BEAT EVERY NATIONAL WEATHER MODEL CAN TELL YOUR BUSINESS WHAT'S COMING
slides.body:
Logistics companies and event planners lose money when forecasts miss.

WeatherNext 3 means faster calls, no meteorologist on staff.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: GOOGLE'S AI READS THE SKY IN REAL TIME
slides.body: Weather forecasting ran on 70-year-old physics until now Google's AI learned from real-time live observations Faster and more localized than any existing model Send this to someone who checks the weather every morning

caption:
Swipe through. Google's new AI skipped 70 years of weather physics and now predicts what's happening on your block before your city forecast does. 🌧️

The 70-year belief that weather had to be simulated with physics equations, how WeatherNext 3 learned directly from real-world observations instead, why it produces street-level forecasts faster than existing models, the billions governments spent on weather supercomputers that Google just bypassed, and what it means for national weather services now facing a direct AI competitor.

Weather forecasting has run on atmospheric physics for 70 years. AI just rewrote it. National weather services are now facing a direct competitor. The question is how fast they adapt.

Running a business with outdoor operations? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what real-time AI data could do for yours.

Sources: Google DeepMind, Google Research
